name: Spinach & Tomato Homestyle Curry
description: A comforting, nutrient-dense curry made with fresh spinach leaves and ripe juicy tomatoes, lightly spiced with turmeric and garlic.
instructions: Wash and roughly chop the spinach leaves. Dice the tomatoes and onion finely.
Heat cooking oil in a pan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and diced onions, sautéing until translucent.
Add diced tomatoes and turmeric. Cook for 5 minutes until tomatoes soften into a fragrant pulp.
Add chopped spinach and stir well. Cover and simmer for 5-7 minutes until tender.
Season with salt and serve hot with flatbread or rice.

name: Hearty Tomato & Herb Omelette
description: Fluffy beaten eggs folded over sautéed diced tomatoes, crisp onions, and aromatics.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk eggs vigorously with a pinch of salt and black pepper.
Heat oil in a non-stick skillet. Sauté onions and tomatoes for 2 minutes until lightly softened.
Pour whisked eggs evenly over the vegetables.
Cook on medium-low heat until the edges set, then flip or fold in half.
Cook for another 1 minute and slide onto a warm plate.

name: Golden Potato & Onion Stir-Fry
description: Crispy pan-fried potato cubes tossed with golden sliced onions and aromatic spices.
instructions: Peel potatoes and cut into bite-sized 1-inch cubes. Slice onions into thin strips.
Heat oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat. Add garlic and onions, cooking until lightly browned.
Add cubed potatoes, turmeric, and salt. Stir to coat evenly in oil.
Cover and cook on medium-low heat for 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally until potatoes are golden and tender.
Uncover for the last 2 minutes for extra crispiness.

name: Rustic Spinach & Potato Mash Frittata
description: A wholesome bake combining wilted spinach, diced tender potatoes, and eggs for a zero-waste dinner.
instructions: Parboil or microwave diced potato cubes until tender (approx 3 minutes).
Sauté onions and spinach in oil in an oven-safe skillet until spinach is wilted.
Spread boiled potatoes evenly in the pan.
Pour beaten eggs over the mixture and cook on low heat until bottom is golden.
Flip or finish under a broiler for 2 minutes until set.

name: Creamy Tomato & Garlic Lentil Dal
description: Hearty yellow lentils simmered with juicy tomatoes, tender spinach, and tempered with fried garlic.
instructions: Rinse lentils and pressure cook or boil in water with a pinch of turmeric until soft.
In a separate saucepan, heat oil. Add sliced garlic and onions, cooking until aromatic.
Add diced tomatoes and cook down into a sauce.
Add chopped spinach and simmer for 3 minutes.
Pour cooked lentils into the vegetable mixture, adjust salt and water, and simmer for 5 minutes.

name: Quick Garlic Sautéed Greens
description: Fresh vibrant spinach flash-cooked with golden garlic slices and a drizzle of olive or vegetable oil.
instructions: Thinly slice garlic cloves. Thoroughly rinse and drain spinach.
Warm oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sauté garlic for 1 minute until fragrant and lightly golden (do not burn).
Add spinach in batches, tossing gently with tongs as it wilts.
Cook for only 2-3 minutes until completely wilted but bright green.
Season with salt and serve immediately as a vibrant side dish.
